subject: Researching R distributions for Hadoop... should my company use Revolution R Open?

messages.author: 3669f3442612b991
messages.subject: Researching R distributions for Hadoop... should my company use Revolution R Open?
parts:
Hi,

I'm urgently researching R vendors for my (large) company.

I'm looking at: H2O, Rev R, and TIBCO Terr because I need to choose a company that provides support and is supported by Cloudera Hadoop.  It also must take advantage of the parallel processing of HDFS.

We're currently a big SAS shop, and I've heard from some SAS users that RRO won't always have the modules that we need.  But I thought with CRAN you can find pretty much anything you need. Cloudera told me that maybe the problem is some modules don't work well with parallel processing.

So one of my questions is, how can I determine which modules work well with parallel processing on Hadoop, and which don't?  Is there a list somewhere on Revolution's website?

Mainly I need to support in R what was done in SAS/Stats and Base SAS.

Thanks!
Dave

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: Researching R distributions for Hadoop... should my company use Revolution R Open?
parts:
Hi, Dave

Thank you for your query.

To support the functionality you are looking for, I suggest you investigate Revolution R Enterprise (RRE).  RRE contains functionality for scalability and performance across clusters, including Cloudera.

http://www.revolutionanalytics.com/revolution-r-enterprise

Regards

Andrie
